description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Internship offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyUpdatesComplete" name="Company status updates complete"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Internship offers" sourceRef="Task_SendOffers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyUpdatesComplete" name="Company updates complete" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdatesComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceiveUpdatesComplete" messageRef="Message_CompanyUpdatesComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweets" name="Recommendation tweets" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="Participant_Twitter" messageRef="Message_Tweet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Applicant" name="Begin internship search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails" name="Enter experience and hobbies?" default="Flow_SkipOptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" name="Continue search"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive an offer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept or deny the offer?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusSplit" name="Complete status updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WeeklyUpdates" name="Write at least 3 status updates every week"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternshipFinished" name="Internship finished?"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveUpdatesComplete" name="Wait for company status updates" messageRef="Message_CompanyUpdatesComplete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusJoin" name="Status updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTweets" name="Send recommendation tweets to friends" messageRef="Message_Tweet">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfFriends</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Applicant" name="Recommendations sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_Applicant" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterOptionalDetails" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">enterExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipOptionalDetails" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalDetailsMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerAccepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerDenied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_StatusSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusApplicant" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusSplit" targetRef="Task_WeeklyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusCompany" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveUpdatesComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WeeklyToFinished" sourceRef="Task_WeeklyUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueWeeklyUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Task_WeeklyUpdates">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internshipNotFinished</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WeeklyUpdatesComplete" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Gateway_StatusJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internshipFinished</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyUpdatesComplete" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveUpdatesComplete" targetRef="Gateway_StatusJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusJoin" targetRef="Task_SendTweets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="End_Applicant"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company internship activities" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Company" name="Begin offer process"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffers" name="Send internship offers" messageRef="Message_Offer">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfOffers</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" name="Write 3 status updates about the intern"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdatesComplete" name="Notify applicant that company updates are complete" messageRef="Message_CompanyUpdatesComplete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Company" name="Company status updates complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_Company" targetRef="Task_SendOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendOffers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" targetRef="Task_SendUpdatesComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdatesComplete" targetRef="End_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
